data.rationale: The proposal captures the right procedure (two Xe USD conversions, timeanddate city search, a draft email to procurement with the subject and body template), but it separates the amount from the currency into four parameters where the true workflow uses one quote value for both fields. It also leaves the To/Subject/Body clicks vague, adds a timezone to the body, and ends with "Send or discard" when the true workflow requires Discard and never Send, so an automation built from it could send the email by mistake.
